3968-4050-4078-6559.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 4 or higher.
3968-4050-4078-6559.description:
Activate Chainer by paying {B}{B}{B} and 3 life, returning Grave Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Grave Titan enters, it triggers, creating two 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing Grave Titan and the two Zombies, adding {B}{B}{B}
When Grave Titan and the Zombie tokens die, Venerated Stormsinger triggers three times, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life for each trigger.
Repeat.

512-527-950.easyPrerequisites: Selvala and Fatestitcher do not have summoning sickness.
512-527-950.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 3 or greater.
512-527-950.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {G}{W}{W}
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Fatestitcher and Selvala, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Fatestitcher ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-527-950.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Selvala's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

1168-1479-2841-8103.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Verdant Catacombs.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1168-1479-2841-8103.description:
Fetch a land using Verdant Catacombs.
When the fetched land enters, Toggo and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Toggo trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Toggo from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Toggo triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

728-3175-3605-4812.description:
Cast Animate Dead by paying {1}{B}.
When Animate Dead enters, it trigger, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Animate Dead to it.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, targeting Dance of the Dead.
Holding priority, activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Sun Titan.
Resolve the Sun Titan trigger, returning Dance of the Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dance of the Dead enters, it trigger, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Dance of the Dead to it.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, targeting Animate Dead.
Holding priority, activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Sun Titan.
Resolve the Sun Titan trigger, returning Animate Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

222-527-4359-8095.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-4359-8095.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Hammerhead twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

341-1621-2146-6867.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Wispweaver Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Wispweaver Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Wispweaver Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

4905-5220-5332-6900.description:
Activate Fanatical Firebrand by tapping and sacrificing it.
When Fanatical Firebrand dies, Mortuary and Carmen trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Fanatical Firebrand from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Carmen trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen.
Resolve the Fanatical Firebrand ability.
Cast Fanatical Firebrand from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

339-677-2511-6633.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3101-3292-3499-3892.easyPrerequisites: You have an amount of {R} available equal to three minus the number of +1/+1 counters on Runaway Steam-Kin.
3101-3292-3499-3892.description:
If Runaway Steam-Kin has three or more +1/+1 counters on it, activate it by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Cast Spear Spewer by paying {R}.
Runaway Steam-Kin triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Spear Spewer by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to each player.
Dissipation Field triggers, returning Spear Spewer from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
3101-3292-3499-3892.notes: It is recommended to perform this combo when you have more life than your opponents to end the game, but it is not required. If this combo will not end the game, stop once you have 1 life.

3293-5282-6797.notablePrerequisites: You have a Plains exiled by Wormfang Newt.
3293-5282-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Wormfang Newt.
When Wormfang Newt dies, its second ability triggers, returning a Plains from exile to the battlefield.
When the Plains enters the battlefield, Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Holding priority, activate the Plains by tapping it, adding {W}.
Resolve the Emeria Shepherd trigger, returning Wormfang Newt from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Newt enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling a Plains.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1744-3487-5770-6753.description:
Cast Rite of Replication with kicker by paying {7}{U}{U}, creating ten token copies of Aetherstorm Roc.
When the Aetherstorm Roc tokens enter the battlefield, each Aetherstorm Roc you control triggers ten times, causing you to get 110 {E}.
Activate Architect of the Untamed by paying eight {E}, creating a 6/6 Beast artifact creature token.
When the Beast enters the battlefield, each Aetherstorm Roc you control triggers, causing you to get eleven {E}.
Repeat from step 3.

252-955-4871.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature and have a way to cause that creature to die.
252-955-4871.description:
Kill any other creature you control.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token that enters the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a +1/+1 counter and without summoning sickness

1084-3143-4613-4762.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1084-3143-4613-4762.description:
Activate Xavier Sal's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Xavier Sal using Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Xavier Sal ability, untapping it.
Repeat.

2645-4929-6602.notablePrerequisites: You have had three nontoken creatures enter the battlefield under your control this turn.
2645-4929-6602.description:
Activate Tromell by paying {1} and tapping it, causing you to put at least three +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding six {C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3}, untapping Tromell.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

331-791-3693-6257.notablePrerequisites:
You have max speed.
You have a way to give Walking Ballista lifelink.
Walking Ballista has at least two +1/+1 counters on it, or your life total is at least 4.
331-791-3693-6257.description:
Give Walking Ballista lifelink, if needed.
If Walking Ballista has less than two +1/+1 counters on it, activate Unspeakable Symbol by paying 3 life, putting a +1/+1 counter on Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 4 damage to an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls, and causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat from step 2.

3908-5315-5365.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Clue token.
Spark Double on the battlefield as a copy of Lonis.
3908-5315-5365.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing a Clue.
Lonis and Spark Double's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Spark Double.
Spark Double's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Spark Double trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lonis.
Lonis' first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.
3908-5315-5365.notes: You may optionally target any other creature using one of the triggers to put infinite +1/+1 counters on that creature.

225-1170-1418-2733-5954.notablePrerequisites: Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
225-1170-1418-2733-5954.description:
Cast Shimmering Wings by paying {U}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere land tokens enter the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers that many times.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping an Everywhere token.
Repeat from step 5 for the remaining trigger.
Resolve the Shimmering Wings spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Shimmering Wings by paying {U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1311-5803.notablePrerequisites:
Kitsa does not have summoning sickness.
Kitsa has power 2 or greater.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
1311-5803.description:
Cast Mobilize by paying {G}.
Kitsa's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Holding priority, activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Kitsa's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Mobilize.
Resolve the copy of Mobilize, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat from step 3.

2275-4067-5874.notablePrerequisites:
Sphinx of the Revelation does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least {E}{E}{E}{E}.
You control a mana-producing permanent that can tap to produce at least {W} and a mana-producing permanent that can tap to produce at least {U}.
2275-4067-5874.description:
Activate Sphinx of the Revelation by paying {W}{U}{U}, tapping it and paying at least {E}{E}{E}{E}, causing you to draw at least four cards.
Shabraz triggers for each card drawn this way.
Resolve the first Shabraz trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and putting a +1/+1 counter on Shabraz.
Sphinx of the Revelation triggers, causing you to get {E}.
Repeat from step 3 for each remaining Shabraz trigger.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Sphinx of the Revelation.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping a mana-producing permanent that can produce at least {W} or {U}.
Activate the permanent by tapping it, adding at least {W} or {U}.
Repeat from step 7 until you have {W}{U}{U} available.
Repeat from step 1.
You may pay additional {E} if able to net near-infinite card draw.

108-1308-4013.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Eyeless Watcher.
When Eyeless Watcher enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate three Eldrazi Scions by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

509-662-1267-3933.manaNeeded: {1}{U}{R} available the first turn, with {4} each extra turn
509-662-1267-3933.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
509-662-1267-3933.description:
Activate Liquimetal Coating by tapping it, causing Medomai the Ageless to become an artifact until end of turn.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Medomai the Ageless.
Medomai the Ageless triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Idris by paying {1}{U}{R}.
When Idris enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Medomai the Ageless until Idris leaves the battlefield.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Idris's vanishing ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Activate Karn's Bastion's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, putting a time counter on Idris.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Idris.
Idris triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 6.

1980-3664-3803-5261.description:
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Dream's Grip without paying its mana cost, targeting Isochron Scepter.
Swarm Intelligence triggers, creating a copy of Dream's Grip, targeting Lotus Field.
Resolve both Dream's Grips, untapping Isochron Scepter and Lotus Field.
Repeat.

856-2292-4231-4871.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar
When Cauldron Familar dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Food, a Clue, and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

2367-3490-4050-4772.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding {1}.
Unruly Mob triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, costing you {1} to create two 1/1 Servo creature tokens.
Repeat.

1976-4934-5078.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Amareth triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Amareth trigger, causing you to look at the top card of your library, which will be Sensei's Divining Top, and put it into your hand.
Repeat.
